response_text: The benefits of having a smaller fundamental OS clock time would mean that timing-based tasks would be more accurate. This could be useful in tasks that require high precision and accuracy. However, it would mean that the power consumption would increase and the CPU would need to be used more to handle the increased number of timer interrupts. This would take power and CPU time from the threads and other processes. Thus, having a smaller clock time could be useful in scenarios where accuracy it the most important factor, whereas in areas where there are more threads or processes, a larger clock time would be beneficial.\n
